ruleset.name: search-ranking-optimizer
ruleset.description: Size/complexity rules for spryker-community/search-ranking-optimizer. Runs alongside phpmd-public-methods.xml as a SEPARATE phpmd invocation — PHPMD merges every loaded ruleset's exclude-pattern into one global file-ignore list for a single run, so keeping TooManyPublicMethods' Facade/Factory exemption in its own ruleset (run separately) is the only way to exempt just that one rule without also hiding Facades/Factories from the rules below.
